stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Xavier takes Logan into his school after the X-Men save him and Rogue, and offers to help him uncover his lost past. Logan stays and fights for him.
stages.whoA: Professor X, who takes him in and offers to help him find his past.
stages.whoB: A drifter he takes into his school and turns into an X-Man.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future where Sentinels hunt mutants, Xavier asks Logan to travel back to 1973 and guide his younger self. When history changes, Logan wakes to find Xavier alive and his school thriving.
stages.whoA: Professor X, who sends his mind back to 1973 to save the future.
stages.whoB: The X-Man he sends back in time to change history.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: In 2029, Logan hides the frail, failing Charles in Mexico and keeps his deadly seizures in check with medicine. Charles pushes him to help Laura, and X-24 kills him at the Munson farm.
stages.whoA: His old mentor, frail now, whom he hides and cares for.
stages.whoB: Logan, who cares for him in his last days and buries him.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Logan frees a blindfolded teenage Scott from Stryker's cells on Three Mile Island, and Scott's eye blasts help the captives escape.
stages.whoA: A blindfolded teenager he frees from Stryker's island.
stages.whoB: The stranger who frees him from Stryker's cells.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: At Xavier's school the two clash at once over who leads and over Jean, whom Scott loves and Logan wants. They still fight side by side against Magneto.
stages.whoA: Cyclops, the X-Men's leader and his rival for Jean.
stages.whoB: A hothead newcomer who wants Jean and won't take orders.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Jean treats Logan when he wakes at the mansion, and he falls for her even though she is with Scott. She stays fond of him and keeps him close to the team.
stages.whoA: Dr. Jean Grey, who treats him and whom he falls for.
stages.whoB: Logan, who falls for her though she loves Scott.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Logan and Jean share a kiss, though her heart stays with Scott. At Alkali Lake she stays behind to hold back the flood and save the team, and Logan watches her die.
stages.whoA: Jean, whom he kisses and watches die saving the team.
stages.whoB: Logan, who loves her and watches her sacrifice herself.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: When Logan changes history and wakes in a new 2023, Jean is alive at the school, and he is overcome to see her.
stages.whoA: Jean, alive again in the new future he wakes to.
stages.whoB: Logan, who is overjoyed to find her alive.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Jean returns from Alkali Lake ruled by the Phoenix, the dark power Xavier had locked away. Logan tries to reach the woman he loves, and when she begs him to save her, he kills her with his claws.
stages.whoA: Logan, who loves her and kills her when she begs him to.
stages.whoB: Jean as the Phoenix. He kills her to save everyone.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Guilt over killing Jean haunts Logan in his dreams long afterward. In Japan he finally lets her go.
stages.whoA: Logan, who is haunted by her in his dreams.
stages.whoB: Jean, whose memory haunts him until he lets her go.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Storm and Cyclops save Logan and Rogue from Sabretooth on a snowy road and bring them to Xavier's school. Logan and Storm fight side by side against the Brotherhood.
stages.whoA: Storm, who rescues him in the snow and fights beside him.
stages.whoB: Logan, whom she brings to the school after a rescue.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: After Xavier's death, Storm leads the X-Men, and Logan follows her into the battle at Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: Storm, who leads the X-Men after Xavier dies.
stages.whoB: Logan, who follows her lead at Alcatraz.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Logan lets the runaway Rogue ride with him and promises to look after her. When Magneto uses her to power his machine, Logan saves her by letting her draw on his healing.
stages.whoA: Rogue, the runaway he promises to protect and saves at Liberty Island.
stages.whoB: Logan, her protector, who saves her life with his healing.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: When Rogue thinks about taking the mutant cure, Logan tells her the choice is hers to make.
stages.whoA: Rogue, whom he tells the cure is her choice.
stages.whoB: Logan, who tells her the cure is her choice.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: During Stryker's raid, Bobby leads Logan, Rogue, and John to his parents' house in Boston, where he tells his family he is a mutant.
stages.whoA: Bobby, who leads him to his family's home after the raid.
stages.whoB: Logan, who shepherds him and his friends after the raid.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 2023, Kitty uses her power to send Logan's mind back to 1973 and holds it there, bleeding and exhausted, until history changes.
stages.whoA: Kitty, who sends his mind back to 1973 and holds it there.
stages.whoB: Logan, whose mind she sends back to 1973.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Colossus trains with Logan in the Danger Room, hurling him at a Sentinel, and fights beside him in the battle at Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: Colossus, his teammate, who hurls him into battle.
stages.whoB: Logan, his teammate in the Danger Room and at Alcatraz.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Kurt, who attacked the President under Stryker's control, joins Logan and the X-Men to rescue Xavier and the captive children at Alkali Lake.
stages.whoA: Nightcrawler, who joins the rescue at Alkali Lake.
stages.whoB: Logan, beside whom he fights at Alkali Lake.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Hank quits the government over the cure and fights at Alcatraz, where Logan distracts Magneto so Hank can inject him with the cure.
stages.whoA: Beast, who strips Magneto's powers while he distracts him.
stages.whoB: Logan, who distracts Magneto so he can use the cure.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Magneto kidnaps Rogue to power his machine, and Logan fights through the Brotherhood at the Statue of Liberty to save her.
stages.whoA: Magneto, who kidnaps Rogue to power his machine.
stages.whoB: A clawed X-Man who wrecks his plan at Liberty Island.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: To stop Stryker, Logan works alongside a freed Magneto, until Magneto turns Stryker's Cerebro against every human on Earth.
stages.whoA: Magneto, an uneasy ally against Stryker who betrays them.
stages.whoB: An X-Man he works beside against Stryker.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Magneto leads the Brotherhood's attack on Alcatraz, and Logan keeps him busy while Beast injects him with the cure.
stages.whoA: Magneto, whom he distracts at Alcatraz so Beast can cure him.
stages.whoB: Logan, who helps strip his powers at Alcatraz.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future ruled by Sentinels, Magneto fights beside Xavier and helps send Logan's mind back to 1973.
stages.whoA: Magneto, now fighting beside Xavier to save the future.
stages.whoB: Logan, whom he helps send back to 1973.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Mystique fights Logan at the train station and inside the Statue of Liberty, where he stabs her.
stages.whoA: Mystique, Magneto's shape-shifter, whom he stabs at Liberty Island.
stages.whoB: An X-Man who stabs her at the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Mystique works with the X-Men against Stryker for a time, and teases Logan by taking Jean's form.
stages.whoA: Mystique, who helps against Stryker and teases him as Jean.
stages.whoB: Logan, whom she teases while they work together.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Sabretooth ambushes Logan and Rogue on a snowy road, then fights him again at the train station and on the Statue of Liberty.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, who ambushes him and Rogue in the snow.
stages.whoB: A clawed loner he hunts and fights for Magneto.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: John is one of the students Logan takes to Bobby's family after Stryker's raid. There John sets police cars ablaze, and soon after he leaves to join Magneto.
stages.whoA: John, a hothead student who walks out to join Magneto.
stages.whoB: Logan, who watches over him until he leaves.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Stryker recruits Logan and Victor into Team X, a covert unit of mutant soldiers, and leads them on brutal missions until Logan walks away.
stages.whoA: Stryker, the officer who runs Team X.
stages.whoB: One of his Team X soldiers, who quits.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Stryker lies to Logan to make him Weapon X, bonding adamantium to his skeleton, then shoots him in the head with adamantium bullets that erase his memory.
stages.whoA: Stryker, who makes him Weapon X and steals his memory.
stages.whoB: Weapon X, the living weapon he built and turned on.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Years later Stryker raids Xavier's mansion and taunts Logan with pieces of his past. Logan leaves him chained at Alkali Lake as the dam bursts.
stages.whoA: Stryker, who knows his past and dies at Alkali Lake.
stages.whoB: Logan, his old experiment, who leaves him to drown.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Under Stryker's control, Yuriko fights Logan claw for claw at Alkali Lake, and he kills her by flooding her body with liquid adamantium.
stages.whoA: Lady Deathstrike, Stryker's clawed enforcer, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: Logan, who kills her at Alkali Lake.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Victor is Logan's older half-brother. They flee home as boys and fight side by side through a century of wars, until they join Stryker's Team X.
stages.whoA: His older half-brother, who fights beside him for a century.
stages.whoB: His younger half-brother and comrade in every war.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: After Logan quits, Victor seems to murder Kayla and becomes his enemy. In the end the brothers team up to bring down Weapon XI, and Victor walks away.
stages.whoA: His brother Victor, who seems to kill Kayla.
stages.whoB: His brother, now his enemy, who still helps him fight Weapon XI.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Wade Wilson is the fast-talking swordsman of Team X who fights beside Logan on Stryker's missions.
stages.whoA: Wade, his wisecracking Team X teammate.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Stryker turns Wade into Weapon XI, loaded with stolen mutant powers, and sends him after Logan. Logan and Victor beat him, and Logan cuts off his head.
stages.whoA: Weapon XI, the monster Stryker made from Wade.
stages.whoB: Logan, who cuts off his head.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Agent Zero served beside Logan in Team X. Sent by Stryker to bring him in, he kills the Hudsons, and Logan downs his helicopter and kills him.
stages.whoA: Agent Zero, his old teammate, who kills the Hudsons.
stages.whoB: Logan, his old teammate, who kills him.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Remy thinks Logan works for Stryker and fights him in New Orleans. Then he flies Logan to Stryker's island and helps free the captives there.
stages.whoA: Gambit, who fights him, then flies him to Stryker's island.
stages.whoB: Logan, whom he fights, then flies to the island.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Kayla and Logan live together in the Canadian Rockies, where she teaches school and tells him the legend that gives him the name Wolverine. Then she seems to be murdered by Victor.
stages.whoA: Kayla, the woman he loves and seems to lose to Victor.
stages.whoB: Logan, the man she lives with in the Rockies.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Logan learns Kayla faked her death for Stryker to keep her sister safe, though her love for him was real. She frees the captives and dies, and he no longer remembers her.
stages.whoA: Kayla, who betrayed him to save her sister but loved him.
stages.whoB: Logan, whom she deceived but truly loved.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Logan breaks into Stryker's lab on Three Mile Island and frees Emma, Kayla's sister, along with the other captive mutants.
stages.whoA: Emma, Kayla's sister, whom he frees from Stryker.
stages.whoB: Logan, who frees her from Stryker's lab.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Wraith, his old Team X teammate, helps Logan track down Stryker, until Victor kills him in New Orleans.
stages.whoA: John Wraith, his Team X friend, killed helping him.
stages.whoB: Logan, his old teammate, whom he helps hunt Stryker.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Logan finds his old Team X teammate boxing in Las Vegas, badly out of shape. Fred tells him that Gambit knows the way to Stryker's island.
stages.whoA: Fred Dukes, his old teammate, who points him to Gambit.
stages.whoB: Logan, his old teammate, who comes looking for answers.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: The elderly Hudsons take in Logan after he escapes Weapon X and treat him like a son. Agent Zero kills them the next morning.
stages.whoA: The kind farm couple who shelter him and die for it.
stages.whoB: The stranger they take in, like a son.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Logan protects Mariko from the Yakuza at her grandfather's funeral, and as they run they fall in love. She frees him in the final battle, takes over the family company, and says goodbye.
stages.whoA: Mariko, whom he protects and falls in love with.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Yukio brings Logan to Japan to say goodbye to Ichiro Yashida and fights beside him to save Mariko. Afterward she leaves with him as his self-appointed bodyguard.
stages.whoA: Yukio, his friend and self-appointed bodyguard.
stages.whoB: Logan, the man she brings to Japan and guards.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Posing as Yashida's doctor, Viper plants a parasite in Logan's heart that stops his healing, and later weakens him for the Silver Samurai.
stages.whoA: Viper, who poisons him and steals his healing.
stages.whoB: Logan, whose healing she steals for Yashida.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Logan saved young Ichiro from the Nagasaki blast in 1945. Decades later the dying billionaire brings him to Japan and offers to end his immortality.
stages.whoA: Ichiro, the soldier he saved at Nagasaki.
stages.whoB: The soldier who saved his life at Nagasaki.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Yashida fakes his death and, in the Silver Samurai armor, tries to drain Logan's healing for himself. Mariko stabs him with Logan's claws, and Logan throws him from the tower.
stages.whoA: Yashida, who betrays him to steal his healing.
stages.whoB: Logan, whose healing he tries to steal.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Shingen tries to have his own daughter Mariko killed and duels Logan with a sword. Logan kills him with his claws.
stages.whoA: Shingen, Mariko's father, whom he kills in a duel.
stages.whoB: Logan, who protects Mariko and kills him.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Harada's ninjas capture Logan for Yashida's plan. When he sees he was used, Harada turns to help and is killed by the Silver Samurai.
stages.whoA: Harada, the ninja who captures him, then turns.
stages.whoB: Logan, whom he captures for Yashida.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Mori admits he plotted with Shingen against Mariko, and Logan throws him out a window.
stages.whoA: Mori, Mariko's scheming fiance, whom he throws out a window.
stages.whoB: Logan, who throws him out a window.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Laura was bred from Logan's DNA, and Charles calls her his daughter. Logan at first wants nothing to do with her, then gives his life to protect her, and she calls him her father as he dies.
stages.whoA: His daughter Laura, bred from his DNA.
stages.whoB: Her father, who dies protecting her.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Caliban lives with Logan at the abandoned smelting plant and helps him care for Charles, until the Reavers take him.
stages.whoA: Caliban, who helps him care for Charles.
stages.whoB: Logan, with whom he cares for Charles.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Gabriela begs Logan to drive her and Laura north to safety. The Reavers kill her before they can go.
stages.whoA: Gabriela, the nurse who asks him to save Laura.
stages.whoB: Logan, the driver she pleads with to save Laura.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Will Munson's family take in Logan, Charles, and Laura for a night, and Logan helps them stand up to a bullying farm. X-24 kills the family, and Will dies fighting him.
stages.whoA: The farm family who take him in for a night.
stages.whoB: Logan, the stranger they welcome for dinner.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Logan finds the escaped children in North Dakota and gives his life fighting the Reavers beside them. They bury him before crossing into Canada.
stages.whoA: Laura's fellow escapees, whom he dies defending.
stages.whoB: Logan, who dies saving them and whom they bury.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce and his Reavers hunt Logan across the country to take Laura back to Transigen.
stages.whoA: Pierce, the cyborg who hunts him and Laura.
stages.whoB: Logan, who stands between him and Laura.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Rice, whose father Logan killed escaping Weapon X, bred Laura and X-24 at Transigen. Logan shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: Rice, the scientist behind Laura and X-24, whom he shoots.
stages.whoB: The man who killed his father, and whom he hates.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: X-24 is a feral clone of Logan in his prime, built to kill. He murders Charles and the Munsons and mortally wounds Logan.
stages.whoA: X-24, his younger clone, who kills Charles and him.
stages.whoB: The aging original he is made to destroy.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Charles and Erik are old friends who long ago took opposite sides over humanity. After the X-Men stop his machine, Charles visits him in his plastic prison to play chess.
stages.whoA: Magneto, his old friend and rival.
stages.whoB: Charles, his old friend on the other side.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: The two once visited young Jean together to bring her to the school. Now they race to her family home, where the Phoenix kills Charles and leaves with Erik.
stages.whoA: Erik, who watches him die and takes Jean.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future ruled by Sentinels, the old rivals fight side by side and send Logan back to change history.
stages.whoA: Erik, his old rival, now fighting beside him.
stages.whoB: Charles, beside whom he makes a last stand.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Xavier's voice guides the blinded teenage Scott and the other children freed from Stryker's island to safety, and he welcomes them.
stages.whoA: Scott, the boy he leads to safety and raises at his school.
stages.whoB: Professor X, who rescues him and raises him as an X-Man.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Jean is one of Xavier's first students and helps him run the school. She uses Cerebro to save him after Mystique poisons it.
stages.whoA: Jean, one of his first students.
stages.whoB: Professor X, who has taught her since she was a girl.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Xavier long held back the dark side of Jean's power with mental blocks. Free of them as the Phoenix, she resents him and tears him apart at her childhood home.
stages.whoA: Jean as the Phoenix, who destroys him.
stages.whoB: The mentor who caged her, whom she destroys.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Ororo is one of Xavier's first X-Men and a teacher at his school. After his death, she takes over as headmistress.
stages.whoA: Storm, one of his first X-Men.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Xavier takes in Rogue after her power puts a boy in a coma, and the X-Men save her from Magneto's machine.
stages.whoA: Rogue, the runaway he takes in.
stages.whoB: Professor X, who gives her a home.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Kitty, once a student at his school, sends Logan's mind back to 1973 while Xavier guides the plan.
stages.whoA: Kitty, his former student, who sends Logan back.
stages.whoB: Professor X, whose plan she carries out.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Xavier reads Kurt's mind to learn who sent him after the President. Kurt then helps Storm free Xavier from Stryker's Cerebro.
stages.whoA: Nightcrawler, who helps free him from Stryker.
stages.whoB: Professor X, who reads his mind and whom he rescues.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Hank is an old friend of Xavier's. He warns him about the cure and fights for his school after Xavier is gone.
stages.whoA: Hank, his old friend in government.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Moira is a doctor and a friend of Xavier's who cares for a comatose patient. After his death, the patient greets her with Xavier's voice.
stages.whoA: Moira, his friend, who finds his voice in her patient.
stages.whoB: Charles, whose voice speaks from her patient.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Posing as Bobby, Mystique sabotages Cerebro, and it nearly kills Xavier.
stages.whoA: Mystique, who sabotages Cerebro to kill him.
stages.whoB: Xavier, whom she nearly kills through Cerebro.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Stryker blames Xavier for failing to cure his son. He captures Xavier and forces him to use a copy of Cerebro to target every mutant.
stages.whoA: Stryker, who captures him to kill every mutant.
stages.whoB: Xavier, whom he blames for his son and uses.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Jason was once brought to Xavier's school as a boy. Now he traps Xavier in illusions for his father so Cerebro can target every mutant.
stages.whoA: Jason, his old pupil, who traps him in illusions.
stages.whoB: His old teacher, whom he traps in illusions for his father.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Through Logan's mind, the older Xavier speaks to his broken younger self in 1973 and urges him to hope again.
stages.whoA: His younger self, whom he urges to hope again.
stages.whoB: His older self, who urges him to hope again.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Charles insists they help Laura and treats her with a grandfather's kindness. She shields him from bullets and rages when X-24 kills him.
stages.whoA: Laura, the girl he insists they save.
stages.whoB: Charles, who is kind to her like a grandfather.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Caliban helps Logan hide and care for the failing Charles at the smelting plant.
stages.whoA: Caliban, who helps care for him.
stages.whoB: Charles, the frail old man he helps look after.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: The Munsons welcome Charles to their dinner table for a night he calls the best he has had in a long time. X-24 kills him in their house.
stages.whoA: The family who give him one last happy night.
stages.whoB: The kind old man they welcome to dinner.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: X-24 stabs Charles to death at the Munson farm, and Charles dies believing it was Logan.
stages.whoA: X-24, Logan's clone, who kills him.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce's Reavers hunt Charles along with Logan and Laura, until one of Charles's seizures freezes them in place.
stages.whoA: Pierce, whose Reavers hunt him.
stages.whoB: The old telepath whose seizure freezes his men.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 2023, Sentinels hunt Xavier and the last mutants to a temple in China, and he sends Logan back to stop them from ever being built.
stages.whoA: The Sentinels, who hunt mutants to near extinction.
stages.whoB: One of the last mutants they hunt.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Mystique is Magneto's most loyal lieutenant, a spy who can wear any face for his plans.
stages.whoA: Mystique, his most loyal lieutenant.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: When Mystique takes a cure dart meant for Magneto and loses her powers, he abandons her. She tells the government where to find him.
stages.whoA: Mystique, whom he abandons once she is cured.
stages.whoB: Magneto, who abandons her and whom she betrays.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Sabretooth serves Magneto's Brotherhood and captures Rogue for his machine.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, his brute in the Brotherhood.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Toad serves Magneto's Brotherhood and helps him take Senator Kelly and Rogue.
stages.whoA: Toad, one of his Brotherhood.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: At Alkali Lake, Magneto tempts John to leave the X-Men and join him. John fights in his Brotherhood at Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: Pyro, the X-Men student he lures away.
stages.whoB: Magneto, who lures him away from the X-Men.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Magneto kidnaps the anti-mutant senator and tests his machine on him, turning him into a mutant. Kelly dies as his body turns to water.
stages.whoA: Senator Kelly, whom he mutates with his machine.
stages.whoB: Magneto, who kidnaps and mutates him.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Magneto kidnaps Rogue and uses her power to run his machine, though it may kill her.
stages.whoA: Rogue, whom he uses to power his machine.
stages.whoB: Magneto, who kidnaps her to power his machine.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: At Alcatraz, Hank injects Magneto with the cure and strips his powers.
stages.whoA: Beast, who strips his powers with the cure.
stages.whoB: Magneto, whom he cures at Alcatraz.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Years ago Magneto and Xavier visited Jean as a girl. Now he recruits the Phoenix, and she stands with him at Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: The Phoenix, whom he recruits to his side.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Magneto frees Juggernaut from a prison convoy, and he joins the Brotherhood's attack on Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: Juggernaut, whom he frees and recruits.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Callisto uses her power to find mutants for Magneto and joins his Brotherhood.
stages.whoA: Callisto, who tracks mutants for him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Magneto frees Multiple Man from a prison convoy and uses his copies as a decoy to fool the soldiers.
stages.whoA: Multiple Man, whom he frees and uses as a decoy.
stages.whoB: Magneto, who frees and uses him.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Stryker drugs Magneto in his prison to learn about Cerebro. Magneto later turns Stryker's own Cerebro against humanity.
stages.whoA: Stryker, who drugs him for secrets.
stages.whoB: Magneto, whom he drugs for secrets.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 2023, Magneto fights the Sentinels at the Chinese temple and is badly hurt.
stages.whoA: The Sentinels, who hunt him and his kind.
stages.whoB: One of the last mutants they hunt.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Disguised as an aide, Mystique helps kidnap Kelly for Magneto. After he dies, she takes his place in public.
stages.whoA: Kelly, whom she kidnaps and then impersonates.
stages.whoB: Mystique, who kidnaps him and steals his face.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Posing as Bobby, Mystique scares Rogue into running away from the school so Magneto can take her.
stages.whoA: Rogue, whom she tricks into running away.
stages.whoB: Mystique, who tricks her into running.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Mystique sneaks into Stryker's base, steals his plans, and poses as him to turn his scheme against him.
stages.whoA: Stryker, whom she spies on and impersonates.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Jean speaks against Kelly's Mutant Registration Act before Congress while he argues that mutants are dangerous.
stages.whoA: Jean, who argues against his registration act.
stages.whoB: Senator Kelly, whose anti-mutant act she fights.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Scott and Jean are a couple and the heart of Xavier's X-Men.
stages.whoA: Jean, the woman he loves.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Stryker brainwashes Scott into fighting Jean. At Alkali Lake she gives her life to save the team, and Scott is devastated.
stages.whoA: Jean, whom he is forced to fight and then loses.
stages.whoB: Scott, whom she fights under Stryker's spell and leaves behind.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: When Logan changes history, Scott and Jean are alive and together at the school.
stages.whoA: Jean, alive and with him in the new future.
stages.whoB: Scott, alive and with her again.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Grieving Jean, Scott goes to Alkali Lake, and she rises from the water as the Phoenix. She kisses him and kills him.
stages.whoA: Jean as the Phoenix, who kills him with a kiss.
stages.whoB: Scott, the man she loved, whom she kills.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Scott and Storm rescue Logan and Rogue from Sabretooth and lead the X-Men together against Magneto.
stages.whoA: Storm, his fellow X-Man.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Stryker captures teenage Scott for his eye blasts and holds him on Three Mile Island.
stages.whoA: Stryker, who kidnaps him as a teen.
stages.whoB: A teenager he kidnaps for his power.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Years later Stryker brainwashes Cyclops and turns him against Jean.
stages.whoA: Stryker, who brainwashes him.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: At the Statue of Liberty, Cyclops blasts Sabretooth out of the statue's head.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, whom he blasts off the statue.
stages.whoB: Cyclops, who blasts him off the statue.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Jean and Storm track Nightcrawler to a Boston church and bring him to the team.
stages.whoA: Storm, her fellow X-Man.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Jean and Storm find Kurt hiding in a church, and Jean reads his mind to learn about Stryker.
stages.whoA: Nightcrawler, whose mind she reads for clues.
stages.whoB: Jean, who finds him and reads his mind.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Storm warms to the gentle Kurt as they talk about faith and anger. Together they free Xavier from Stryker's Cerebro.
stages.whoA: Kurt, a gentle soul she befriends.
stages.whoB: Storm, who befriends him and fights beside him.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: At the Statue of Liberty, Storm strikes Toad with lightning, and he falls into the water.
stages.whoA: Toad, whom she strikes with lightning.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Storm kills Callisto in their fight at Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: Callisto, whom she kills at Alcatraz.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Storm and Kurt break through Jason's illusion to free Xavier, and Jason is left behind as the base floods.
stages.whoA: Jason, whose illusion she breaks to save Xavier.
stages.whoB: Storm, who breaks his hold on Xavier.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: After refusing his father's cure, Warren comes to Storm's school, saying he was told it was a safe place for mutants.
stages.whoA: Warren, the winged boy who seeks shelter at her school.
stages.whoB: Storm, who welcomes him to the school.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 2023, Storm dies fighting the Sentinels at the Chinese temple.
stages.whoA: The Sentinels, who kill her.
stages.whoB: One of the X-Men they kill.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Bobby befriends Rogue when she arrives at Xavier's school.
stages.whoA: Bobby, her first friend at the school.
stages.whoB: Rogue, the new girl he befriends.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Rogue and Bobby are now a couple, though a kiss nearly kills him.
stages.whoA: Bobby, her boyfriend, whom she cannot touch.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Rogue watches Bobby grow close to Kitty and takes the cure so she can touch him. They are together again at the end.
stages.whoA: Bobby, her boyfriend, whom she takes the cure for.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: In Storm's class, John flaunts a ball of fire for Rogue and Bobby freezes it, a friendly rivalry between classmates.
stages.whoA: John, his hotheaded classmate.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: John travels with Bobby's group after Stryker's raid, then leaves the X-Men to join Magneto.
stages.whoA: John, who walks out on them for Magneto.
stages.whoB: Bobby, the friend he leaves behind.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: At Alcatraz, Bobby beats Pyro in a duel of ice against fire.
stages.whoA: Pyro, whom he beats at Alcatraz.
stages.whoB: Iceman, who beats him in a duel.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Bobby and Kitty grow close, skating on an iced pond, which makes Rogue jealous.
stages.whoA: Kitty, a friend he grows close to.
stages.whoB: Bobby, whom she grows close to.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: At Alcatraz, Kitty tricks Juggernaut into charging headfirst into a wall.
stages.whoA: Juggernaut, whom she tricks into a wall.
stages.whoB: Kitty, who knocks him out with a trick.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Kitty phases through walls to save Jimmy from Juggernaut at Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: Jimmy, the boy she saves at Alcatraz.
stages.whoB: Kitty, who saves him from Juggernaut.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Juggernaut hunts Jimmy at Alcatraz to stop the cure made from his genes.
stages.whoA: Jimmy, the boy he hunts.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 2023, Kitty sends Bishop's mind back in time to warn the group of each Sentinel attack.
stages.whoA: Bishop, whose mind she sends back to warn them.
stages.whoB: Kitty, who sends his mind back in time.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Blink's portals help hold off the Sentinels and buy Kitty time to send Bishop back.
stages.whoA: Blink, whose portals buy her time.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Warpath senses the Sentinels coming and fights to buy Kitty time to send Bishop back.
stages.whoA: Warpath, who senses the Sentinels and protects her.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Sunspot fights the Sentinels to buy Kitty time to send Bishop back.
stages.whoA: Sunspot, who fights to protect her.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 2023, Colossus guards Kitty while she sends minds back through time, and he dies holding off the Sentinels.
stages.whoA: Colossus, who guards her and dies for the plan.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Bishop leads his small band against the Sentinels, and the final attack kills him.
stages.whoA: The Sentinels, who kill him.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Blink's portals help the X-Men outrun the Sentinels, until the final attack kills her.
stages.whoA: The Sentinels, who kill her.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Stryker controls Kurt with a serum and sends him to attack the President.
stages.whoA: Stryker, who controls him and sends him to kill.
stages.whoB: Kurt, whom he uses as an assassin.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Under Stryker's control, Yuriko serves as his silent enforcer at Alkali Lake.
stages.whoA: Stryker, who controls her.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Stryker's son Jason is a mutant, and Stryker keeps him frozen in cryogenic suspension.
stages.whoA: Jason, his mutant son.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Stryker blames mutants for what happened to his son. He uses Jason's illusions to control Xavier and leaves him behind as the base floods.
stages.whoA: Jason, his son, whom he uses as a weapon.
stages.whoB: His father, who uses him and leaves him to drown.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Kayla spies on Logan for Stryker in return for her sister's freedom.
stages.whoA: Kayla, his spy on Logan.
stages.whoB: Stryker, who forces her to spy on Logan.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: When Stryker breaks his promise, Kayla turns on him and helps free his captives. Dying, she uses her power to make him walk away.
stages.whoA: Kayla, who turns on him.
stages.whoB: Stryker, who betrays her and whom she drives off.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Stryker holds Emma prisoner in his lab on Three Mile Island to keep her sister in line.
stages.whoA: Emma, his prisoner, held to control her sister.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Remy is the only mutant who ever escaped Stryker's island, and he returns to help free the others.
stages.whoA: Gambit, the one prisoner who escaped him.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Victor hunts mutants for Stryker, who refuses him the adamantium he was promised.
stages.whoA: Victor, his hunter, whom he cheats.
stages.whoB: Stryker, who uses and cheats him.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Stryker turns his Team X mercenary Wade Wilson into Weapon XI and unleashes him on Logan.
stages.whoA: Weapon XI, whom he builds from Wade.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Agent Zero is Stryker's loyal sharpshooter, sent to bring Logan in.
stages.whoA: Agent Zero, his loyal gunman.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Victor helps Kayla fake her death for Stryker. When she tries to turn him against Stryker, he chokes her and promises to kill her for real.
stages.whoA: Kayla, whose death he fakes and whom he attacks.
stages.whoB: Victor, who fakes her death and turns on her.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Victor kills his former Team X teammate Wraith in New Orleans.
stages.whoA: Wraith, his old teammate, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: Victor, his old teammate, who kills him.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Victor tracks down his former Team X teammate Bradley at a carnival and kills him.
stages.whoA: Bradley, his old teammate, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: Victor, his old teammate, who kills him.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Victor teams up with Logan to fight Weapon XI on the cooling tower.
stages.whoA: Weapon XI, whom he fights beside Logan.
stages.whoB: Victor, who helps bring him down.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Using Cable's device, Deadpool goes back in time and shoots the Weapon XI version of himself dead.
stages.whoA: His other self, who comes back to shoot him.
stages.whoB: The Weapon XI version of himself, whom he shoots.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Hunting Logan, Agent Zero kills the elderly Hudsons on their farm.
stages.whoA: The elderly farm couple he kills.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Emma is Kayla's sister. Kayla works for Stryker only to free her, and in the end Logan frees her.
stages.whoA: Emma, her sister.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Ichiro is Mariko's grandfather, who leaves her his company. When he reveals his plan to steal Logan's healing, she stabs him with Logan's claws.
stages.whoA: Her grandfather, who betrays Logan.
stages.whoB: His granddaughter and heir, who kills him.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Shingen is Mariko's father. Furious that she is the heir, he sends Yakuza to kidnap her at her grandfather's funeral and later tries to kill her.
stages.whoA: Her father, who tries to have her killed.
stages.whoB: His daughter, whom he tries to kill.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: The Yashida family took in the orphaned Yukio and raised her as Mariko's adopted sister and protector.
stages.whoA: Yukio, her adopted sister and protector.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Harada is Mariko's former love and sworn protector. He rescues her from her father, and dies after turning on Yashida for her.
stages.whoA: Harada, her former love and protector.
stages.whoB: Mariko, the woman he once loved and protects.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Mori is engaged to Mariko for political gain, and he plots with her father against her.
stages.whoA: Her fiance, who plots against her.
stages.whoB: His fiancee, whom he plots against.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Shingen is Ichiro's son, passed over when Ichiro leaves the company to Mariko.
stages.whoA: Shingen, his son.
stages.whoB: His father, who leaves the company to Mariko.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Viper serves Yashida, posing as his doctor and poisoning Logan for him.
stages.whoA: Viper, his doctor and agent.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Harada and his ninjas serve Yashida. When Harada turns against him, Yashida kills him in the Silver Samurai armor.
stages.whoA: Harada, his servant, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: Yashida, his master, who kills him.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Yashida sends Yukio around the world to find Logan and bring him to Japan.
stages.whoA: Yukio, whom he raised and sends to find Logan.
stages.whoB: Yashida, who raised her and sends her for Logan.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Yukio defends Logan when Shingen attacks him at the family home.
stages.whoA: Yukio, who defends Logan against him.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: Shingen and Mori conspire together against Mariko over the company.
stages.whoA: Mori, his fellow conspirator.

stages.title: The Wolverine
stages.text: In the final battle, Yukio kills Viper by hanging her in an elevator shaft.
stages.whoA: Yukio, who kills her.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Gabriela, a Transigen nurse, smuggles Laura out and tries to get her to safety. The Reavers kill her.
stages.whoA: Gabriela, the nurse who smuggles her out.
stages.whoB: Laura, the girl she saves from Transigen.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Laura reunites with the other escaped children in North Dakota, and they fight the Reavers and cross toward Canada together.
stages.whoA: The other children bred at Transigen.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce and the Reavers hunt Laura to bring her back to Transigen.
stages.whoA: Pierce, who hunts her.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Rice runs the program that created Laura as a weapon.
stages.whoA: Rice, the scientist who made her a weapon.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: X-24 captures Laura and kills Logan, and Laura shoots him in the head with an adamantium bullet.
stages.whoA: X-24, Logan's clone, whom she kills.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce tortures Caliban into tracking Laura. Caliban sets off grenades to kill himself and the Reavers around him.
stages.whoA: Pierce, who forces him to track Laura.
stages.whoB: Caliban, whom he forces to track mutants.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce's Reavers hunt Gabriela for taking Laura, and they kill her.
stages.whoA: Pierce, whose men kill her.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: X-24 kills the Munson family in their home.
stages.whoA: X-24, who kills them.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: The children combine their powers and kill Pierce and his Reavers.
stages.whoA: Pierce, the man they kill.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Rice bred the children as weapons and planned to have them killed.
stages.whoA: Rice, who bred them as weapons.
stages.whoB: The children he bred as weapons.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce is Transigen's security chief, and Rice is the head scientist he answers to.
stages.whoA: Rice, the scientist he works for.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Rice controls X-24, his ultimate weapon.
stages.whoA: X-24, his ultimate weapon.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: As children, Charles finds Raven raiding his family's kitchen and takes her in as his sister. Years later she chooses to be proud of her blue form and leaves him to follow Erik.
stages.whoA: Raven, his adopted sister, who leaves him for Erik.
stages.whoB: Charles, the brother who took her in as a girl.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 1973, Charles sets out to stop Raven from killing Trask. In Washington he reaches her mind, asks her to choose, and lets her go when she spares Trask.
stages.whoA: Raven, his sister, whom he talks out of murder.
stages.whoB: Charles, her brother, who trusts her to choose.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: After leading the X-Men together against Apocalypse, Raven turns on Charles for risking them to feed his fame. She dies by Jean's hand soon after, and he steps down in grief.
stages.whoA: Raven, his sister, who dies calling out his pride.
stages.whoB: Charles, her brother, whose pride she can no longer stand.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles saves Erik from drowning as he chases Shaw, and the two become close friends who recruit young mutants together.
stages.whoA: Erik, his closest friend.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: On the beach in Cuba they split over humanity. A bullet Erik deflects leaves Charles paralyzed, and Erik leaves with Raven.
stages.whoA: Erik, the friend who leaves him paralyzed and walks away.
stages.whoB: Charles, the friend he leaves on the beach.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Ten years later Charles helps break Erik out of the Pentagon to stop Raven, but Erik turns on him again and attacks the White House.
stages.whoA: Erik, his old friend, who betrays him again.
stages.whoB: Charles, who frees him and whom he turns on.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: After fighting side by side against Apocalypse, they clash once more when Erik hunts Jean. When it is over, Erik finds Charles in Paris and sits down with him for chess.
stages.whoA: Erik, his old friend, with whom he makes peace in Paris.
stages.whoB: Charles, his old friend, with whom he makes peace.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Moira brings Charles to the CIA, and the two grow fond of each other as they hunt Shaw. After Cuba, he wipes her memory with a kiss to keep his school secret.
stages.whoA: Moira, the CIA agent he works with and falls for.
stages.whoB: Charles, who recruits mutants with her and wipes her memory.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: In 1983 Moira does not remember Charles, though he still cares for her. After they defeat Apocalypse, he gives her memory back and they reconcile.
stages.whoA: Moira, who has forgotten him until he restores her memory.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Hank builds Cerebro for the CIA, and Charles uses it to find and recruit young mutants.
stages.whoA: Hank, the young genius who builds Cerebro.
stages.whoB: Charles, for whom he builds Cerebro.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 1973, Hank is the only one left with Charles at the closed school, caring for him and making the serum that lets him walk.
stages.whoA: Hank, who stays by his side when everyone else is gone.
stages.whoB: Charles, the broken friend he looks after.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Hank blames Charles for Raven's death and walks out to join Erik. Later he makes peace with him and takes over the school.
stages.whoA: Hank, who blames him for Raven, then succeeds him.
stages.whoB: Charles, whom he blames for Raven, then forgives.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles recruits Alex and helps him learn to control his blasts with a target in the bunker.
stages.whoA: Alex, a recruit he teaches to control his power.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles recruits Sean and helps him learn to fly on his scream.
stages.whoA: Sean, a recruit he trains.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles recruits Armando, who is killed by Shaw soon after.
stages.whoA: Armando, a recruit Shaw kills.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles and Erik recruit Angel from a strip club. When Shaw attacks the CIA base, she leaves with him.
stages.whoA: Angel, a recruit who defects to Shaw.
stages.whoB: Charles, who recruits her before she leaves for Shaw.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles hunts Shaw with the CIA, and in Cuba he holds Shaw frozen with his mind while Erik kills him.
stages.whoA: Shaw, the Nazi mutant he hunts.
stages.whoB: Xavier, who freezes him in Cuba.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: After Erik captures Emma in Russia, Charles reads her mind and learns Shaw's plan for war.
stages.whoA: Emma Frost, Shaw's telepath, whose mind he reads.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Charles and Logan recruit Peter to help break Erik out of the Pentagon, and later Peter joins Charles's X-Men.
stages.whoA: Peter, the speedster who helps free Erik.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Years after Logan brushed him off in a bar, a future Logan finds Charles drunk and broken in 1973. Sent by Charles's older self, he gets him back on his feet.
stages.whoA: Logan, sent from the future to get him back on his feet.
stages.whoB: The young Professor X, whom he pushes back to hope.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Charles works to stop Trask's Sentinel program while also saving Trask from Raven.
stages.whoA: Trask, the man whose Sentinels he must stop.
stages.whoB: Xavier, who saves him from Raven.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Apocalypse kidnaps Charles to take over his body and his power. Charles fights him in the mind while Jean destroys him.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, who tries to steal his body.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Charles has raised Jean at his school and helped her hold her power in. Against Apocalypse he tells her to let it all go.
stages.whoA: Jean, his gifted student.
stages.whoB: Professor X, who raised and teaches her.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Jean learns that Charles hid her father being alive and blocked her memories. She turns on him, but in the end she forgives him and saves the mutants.
stages.whoA: Jean, who turns on him, then forgives him.
stages.whoB: Charles, who lied to her about her father.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Alex brings Scott to Charles's school to learn to control his eye blasts, and Scott becomes one of his X-Men.
stages.whoA: Scott, a new student he takes in.
stages.whoB: Professor X, who takes him in.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: After turning on Apocalypse, Ororo joins Charles's school and his new X-Men.
stages.whoA: Ororo, who joins his X-Men.
stages.whoB: Professor X, whose X-Men she joins.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Raven brings Kurt to Charles's school, and he becomes one of the new X-Men.
stages.whoA: Kurt, a new student.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Vuk leads the D'Bari against Charles and the X-Men to take the force inside Jean.
stages.whoA: Vuk, the alien who preys on Jean.
stages.whoB: Xavier, who stands in her way.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Erik tells Raven to be proud of her true blue form, and she leaves with him after Cuba.
stages.whoA: Raven, who leaves with him as Mystique.
stages.whoB: Erik, who tells her to be proud of how she looks.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In Paris, Erik tries to kill Raven so her DNA can never be used to build Sentinels. In Washington she stops him with a plastic gun.
stages.whoA: Raven, whom he tries to kill to stop the Sentinels.
stages.whoB: Erik, who tries to kill her.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Raven asks Charles to find Erik after his family is killed, and in the final battle she helps bring him back to their side.
stages.whoA: Raven, who helps bring him back.
stages.whoB: Erik, the friend she wants back.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Peter helps break Erik out of the Pentagon and jokes that his mother once knew a man who could control metal.
stages.whoA: Peter, the speedster who helps break him out.
stages.whoB: Erik, whom he breaks out of the Pentagon.

stages.text: Peter now knows Erik is his father and comes looking for him. After they defeat Apocalypse, he decides not to tell him yet.
stages.whoA: His son, who hasn't told him.
stages.whoB: His father, who doesn't know it.

stages.text: As a Nazi doctor, Shaw killed Erik's mother to unlock his power. Erik hunts him for years and drives the coin from his childhood through Shaw's skull.
stages.whoA: Shaw, who killed his mother and whom he kills.
