stages.text: When the Demon Bear attacks, Illyana takes up her Soulsword to fight it, and they escape together.
stages.whoA: Illyana, who fights the bear for her.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Sam is one of the teens Dani meets at the hospital. They face their fears together and escape.
stages.whoA: Sam, a friend from the hospital.
stages.whoB: Dani, a friend from the hospital.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Roberto is one of the teens Dani meets at the hospital. They face their fears together and escape.
stages.whoA: Roberto, a friend from the hospital.
stages.whoB: Dani, a friend from the hospital.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Dr. Reyes comforts Dani at first, but she is under orders to kill her. When she tries, the Demon Bear kills her.
stages.whoA: Dr. Reyes, who pretends to help, then tries to kill her.
stages.whoB: Dani, whom she is ordered to kill.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Suspicious of Reyes, Rahne attacks her in wolf form to save Dani.
stages.whoA: Dr. Reyes, whom she attacks to save Dani.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Dr. Reyes holds Illyana in her hidden hospital for the Essex Corporation.
stages.whoA: Dr. Reyes, her jailer.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Dr. Reyes holds Sam in her hidden hospital for the Essex Corporation.
stages.whoA: Dr. Reyes, his jailer.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Dr. Reyes holds Roberto in her hidden hospital for the Essex Corporation.
stages.whoA: Dr. Reyes, his jailer.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: The Demon Bear is born of Dani's own fear and destroyed her reservation. Encouraged by her father's spirit, she faces it and calms it.
stages.whoA: The Demon Bear, born of her own fear.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Illyana fights the Demon Bear with her Soulsword, armor, and dragon Lockheed.
stages.whoA: The Demon Bear, which she battles.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: When Reyes tries to kill Dani, the Demon Bear kills her.
stages.whoA: The Demon Bear, which kills her.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: In the Void, Laura and Gambit fight Cassandra Nova's forces side by side in the resistance.
stages.whoA: Gambit, a fellow resistance fighter.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: In the raid on Cassandra Nova's lair, Laura kills Juggernaut, and the heroes take his helmet.
stages.whoA: Juggernaut, whom she kills.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Scott and Jean are in love despite Wolverine's feelings for her. They marry, are kidnapped on their honeymoon by Sinister's Nasty Boys, and Scott fights the Shi'ar to save her when she becomes the Phoenix.
stages.whoA: Jean, his wife.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Scott learns the woman he lived with was Jean's clone while Jean was Sinister's prisoner, and the two struggle to find their way back to each other. Thrown into 3960 A.D., they help raise young Nathan before coming home.
stages.whoA: Jean, the wife he must find his way back to.
stages.whoB: Scott, the husband she must find her way back to.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Believing she is Jean, Madelyne lives as Scott's wife and gives birth to their son, Nathan. After learning she is Sinister's clone, she leaves the team, though Scott keeps talking to her in his mind.
stages.whoA: Madelyne, the clone wife who bore his son.
stages.whoB: Scott, her husband and the father of her son.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Nathan is Scott's son with Madelyne. Sinister infects the baby, Bishop takes him to the future for a cure, and he returns grown as the soldier Cable.
stages.whoA: Nathan, his son, grown into Cable.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: In 3960 A.D., Scott chooses to stay and help raise young Nathan, and saves him from Apocalypse's followers before returning home.
stages.whoA: Nathan, the son he helps raise in the future.
stages.whoB: His father, who helps raise him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Nathan is the son of Jean's clone Madelyne and Scott. Lost in 3960 A.D., Jean helps raise him as her own and saves him from Apocalypse's followers.
stages.whoA: Nathan, the son she raises as her own.
stages.whoB: Jean, who raises him as a mother.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Madelyne is Nathan's mother. She saves her sick baby from Sinister and gives him to Bishop, and later recognizes the grown Cable as her son.
stages.whoA: Nathan, her son, grown into Cable.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Madelyne is Sinister's clone of Jean, made while the real Jean was his prisoner, and she has lived Jean's life with Scott. Under Sinister's control she attacks the X-Men as the Goblin Queen.
stages.whoA: Madelyne, her clone, who attacks her as the Goblin Queen.
stages.whoB: Jean, the woman she was cloned from.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Jean frees Madelyne's mind using their shared memories, and together they save baby Nathan.
stages.whoA: Madelyne, her clone, whom she frees.
stages.whoB: Jean, who frees her from Sinister.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Sinister made Madelyne as a clone of Jean and turns her into the Goblin Queen. Once free, she turns on him.
stages.whoA: Sinister, the man who made and used her.
stages.whoB: His clone of Jean, who turns on him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Madelyne trusts Bishop with her baby, and he takes Nathan to the future for a cure.
stages.whoA: Bishop, to whom she gives her baby.
stages.whoB: Madelyne, who trusts him with her son.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Alex is Scott's younger brother. When X-Factor clashes with the X-Men at a government site, he fights Scott and neither one's blasts can hurt the other.
stages.whoA: Scott, his older brother.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Corsair is Scott's father, a pilot taken by the Shi'ar who became a space pirate. Scott learns the truth when Corsair comes to Earth on the run, and after a hard argument they make peace.
stages.whoA: Scott, the son he sent away to safety.
stages.whoB: His father, the space pirate Corsair.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Lorna is Magneto's daughter, and her bond with him is strained. After his death, Xavier uses his good memories of Magneto to help her embrace her power.
stages.whoA: Her father, with whom she never made peace.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Lorna was Bobby's girlfriend when they left the X-Men for a normal life. When she vanishes he hunts for her, only to find she has joined X-Factor and moved on.
stages.whoA: Bobby, her former boyfriend.
stages.whoB: Lorna, his former girlfriend, who moved on.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Lorna falls for her X-Factor teammate Alex.
stages.whoA: Alex, her boyfriend in X-Factor.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Lorna and Alex serve together in Valerie Cooper's X-Factor and interrogate Jubilee, until Lorna helps her escape.
stages.whoA: Alex, her partner in X-Factor.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cain Marko is Xavier's stepbrother, who wrecks the mansion hunting him. Later, after Cain loses his power, Xavier restores it to him.
stages.whoA: Cain, his violent stepbrother.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Lilandra seeks Xavier's help against her brother D'Ken, and they fall in love. When Xavier is struck down, she takes him to the Shi'ar to be healed.
stages.whoA: Lilandra, the Shi'ar princess he loves.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Healed and engaged to Lilandra, now empress, Xavier refuses to give up his memories of Earth and leaves her to return home after the Genosha massacre.
stages.whoA: Lilandra, his fiancee, whom he leaves for Earth.
stages.whoB: Charles, her fiance, who returns to Earth.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Moira is Xavier's old love and one of his closest friends, a geneticist who works with him from Muir Island. She cares for him when he is ill.
stages.whoA: Moira, his old love and closest friend.
stages.whoB: Charles, her old love and friend.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sean is Moira's fiance and stands with her on Muir Island.
stages.whoA: Moira, his fiancee.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kevin is Moira's son, a reality warper she keeps safe on Muir Island. When he escapes to find his father, she calls the X-Men for help and takes him home.
stages.whoA: Kevin, her troubled son.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Black Tom is Sean's kin from the Cassidy family, and they grew up as rivals. When Tom and Juggernaut hide Lilandra at Cassidy Castle, Sean guides the X-Men there.
stages.whoA: Sean, his relative and rival.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Deathbird is Lilandra's older sister and attacks her.
stages.whoA: Deathbird, her sister and enemy.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Deathbird refuses to accept Lilandra marrying a man from Earth and challenges the engagement, setting off a battle with the Imperial Guard.
stages.whoA: Deathbird, her sister, who fights her engagement.
stages.whoB: Lilandra, her sister, whose engagement she fights.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: D'Ken is Lilandra's mad brother. She seeks Xavier's help to stop him from seizing the M'Kraan Crystal, and takes the throne after his fall.
stages.whoA: D'Ken, her mad brother.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mystique took in the runaway Rogue and raised her, then sent her to attack Ms. Marvel. Rogue exposes Mystique's disguise on Muir Island and later tells her she is no longer her daughter.
stages.whoA: Mystique, the woman who raised and used her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kurt learns that Mystique is the mother who abandoned him as a baby. He still comes to save her from Graydon, and she risks herself to protect him.
stages.whoA: His mother, who abandoned him as a baby.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kurt learns that Rogue, Mystique's adopted daughter, is his foster sister.
stages.whoA: Kurt, her foster brother.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Lost together in ancient Egypt, they find their way home. Later Kurt offers his own life to the Celestial Eson so Rogue and Gambit can be together.
stages.whoA: Kurt, her brother, who gives his life for her happiness.
stages.whoB: Rogue, his sister, for whom he gives his life.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Graydon is Kurt's half-brother, son of Mystique and Sabretooth. Told to kill his mutant family, he lures Kurt into a trap and fails.
stages.whoA: Graydon, his hateful half-brother.
stages.whoB: Kurt, the mutant half-brother he tries to kill.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: When the Acolytes put Graydon on trial, Kurt defends his half-brother. When Graydon shoots Exodus, Kurt strands him in the Antarctic.
stages.whoA: Graydon, his half-brother, whom he defends, then abandons.
stages.whoB: Kurt, his half-brother, who defends him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Graydon is Mystique's son with Sabretooth, and his hatred of mutants turns on her. He kidnaps her to trap Nightcrawler.
stages.whoA: Graydon, her son, who kidnaps her.
stages.whoB: His mutant mother, whom he uses as bait.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Graydon is Sabretooth's son, and Wolverine exposes the tie to his followers. After his plot against his family fails, he is left on his father's doorstep.
stages.whoA: Graydon, the son who hates him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mystique and Sabretooth are former lovers and Graydon's parents. They still team up at times, including in Apocalypse's service.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, her old lover and the father of her son.
stages.whoB: Mystique, his old lover and the mother of his son.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Remy flirts with Rogue from the start, though her touch can kill. He resents her weekend with her old flame Cody, and they grow closer on a ski trip in Germany.
stages.whoA: Remy, the charming thief she loves.
stages.whoB: Rogue, the woman he loves but cannot touch.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Rogue admits she once had a secret romance with Magneto, and on Genosha she kisses Magneto before realizing she wants Remy. Remy dies saving Genosha, and she is heartbroken.
stages.whoA: Remy, whom she loses on Genosha.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Brought back from the dead, Remy is freed by Rogue and returns to her and the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Remy, back from the dead and with her again.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: As Apocalypse's Horseman Death, Gambit kidnaps Rogue and stages a wedding to bind her to him forever, giving her the X-Ternal's power. Rogue enters his mind and pulls Apocalypse out of him.
stages.whoA: Remy as Death, who kidnaps her to wed her.
stages.whoB: Rogue, whom he kidnaps out of love.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Rogue reveals she had a secret romance with Magneto when she was younger, since his power lets her touch him. She leads Genosha with him and sides with him on Asteroid M.
stages.whoA: Magneto, her secret old flame.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: After the X-Cutioner strips Storm's powers, Forge brings her to his ranch to restore them. They fall for each other, and together they defeat the Adversary.
stages.whoA: Forge, who helps her regain her powers and loves her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Jubilee and Roberto grow close, escape Mojo's deadly video game together, and kiss. Later they join Cable's X-Force together.
stages.whoA: Roberto, her close friend whom she kisses.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Gambit says Apocalypse once loved Candra and gave her part of his power, making her the immortal X-Ternal, but she abandoned him.
stages.whoA: Candra, the woman he once loved.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: In 3960 A.D., Mother Askani tells young Nathan he is destined to kill Apocalypse, and pulls the X-Men through time to train him.
stages.whoA: Mother Askani, who raises him to kill Apocalypse.
stages.whoB: Nathan, the boy she prepares to kill Apocalypse.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier leads the X-Men, with Scott as his field leader.
stages.whoA: Scott, his field leader.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jean is Xavier's first student. Together they fight the Shadow King in the Astral Plane.
stages.whoA: Jean, his first student.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier leads Wolverine on the X-Men, though Logan often clashes with him, as when Xavier tries to reform Sabretooth.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, his most unruly X-Man.
stages.whoB: Professor X, whom he respects but argues with.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ororo is one of Xavier's X-Men.
stages.whoA: Storm, one of his X-Men.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Back home in the 1990s, Xavier names Storm headmistress of his school.
stages.whoA: Storm, whom he names headmistress.
stages.whoB: Professor X, who makes her headmistress.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier took Rogue in and healed her mind after she absorbed Ms. Marvel.
stages.whoA: Rogue, whom he took in and healed.
stages.whoB: Professor X, who took her in.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bobby was one of Xavier's first X-Men, but he never took orders well. Years later he refuses Xavier's offer to come back.
stages.whoA: Bobby, an old student who left.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Lorna returns to Xavier's school, and he helps her face her feelings about her father to defeat Danger.
stages.whoA: Lorna, whom he helps face her father's memory.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Bishop rescues Xavier from ancient Egypt after Magneto's death.
stages.whoA: Bishop, who rescues him from Egypt.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Charles and Erik were once close friends until Erik swore vengeance on humanity. Stranded powerless in the Savage Land, they work together to escape Sinister, then part as enemies again.
stages.whoA: Magneto, his old friend and greatest rival.
stages.whoB: Charles, his old friend and greatest rival.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Xavier leaves the X-Men to Magneto in his will. When Magneto turns on humanity from Asteroid M, Xavier takes over his mind, then helps heal it.
stages.whoA: Magneto, to whom he leaves the X-Men.
stages.whoB: Charles, who trusts him and then stops him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Stranded in ancient Egypt, Magneto tries to guide young En Sabah Nur with Xavier's ideals. Apocalypse kills him in front of a devastated Xavier.
stages.whoA: Erik, his friend, whose death he witnesses.
stages.whoB: Charles, whose ideals he dies trying to teach.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Scott and Logan clash again and again, over Jean and over Scott's call to leave Morph behind.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, his rival for Jean.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Logan loves Jean, but she chooses Scott. She remains close to him.
stages.whoA: Logan, who loves her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Confused by Madelyne's memories, Jean kisses Logan. He turns her away and tells her to talk to Scott.
stages.whoA: Logan, who turns her down.
stages.whoB: Jean, whom he turns down for Scott's sake.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Logan saves Jubilee from the Sentinels and becomes her protector. She looks up to him and tags along on his missions.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, the kid he protects.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Morph is Logan's best friend, the only one who makes him laugh. Logan grieves his apparent death and later tries to bring him back to himself.
stages.whoA: Morph, his best friend.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: After returning from 3960 A.D., Morph joins Logan's raid on a Weapon X lab and is saddened that Logan feels he is nothing without his claws.
stages.whoA: Morph, his friend on the Weapon X raid.
stages.whoB: Logan, his friend, whom he worries about.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Logan lends Rogue his healing to fight off the alien Colony's spores.
stages.whoA: Rogue, whom he saves with his healing.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Logan, Rogue, and Gambit protect Kurt from a fearful mob in Germany, and Logan learns something about faith from him.
stages.whoA: Kurt, the monk who teaches him about faith.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cable deliberately infects Logan with Apocalypse's plague so that his blood can yield a vaccine.
stages.whoA: Cable, who infects him to make a cure.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine once served with Alpha Flight. They capture him for the Canadian government, then turn and help him escape.
stages.whoA: Alpha Flight, his old team.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Black Widow and Captain America hand Wolverine a file on Weapon X.
stages.whoA: Black Widow, who hands him the Weapon X file.
stages.whoB: Wolverine, to whom she gives the file.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jean helps Rogue master Ms. Marvel's psyche inside her.
stages.whoA: Rogue, whom she helps.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Storm and Jean lead the Gold Team against Bastion's Sentinels.
stages.whoA: Storm, her co-leader.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Storm duels the Morlock leader Callisto to free Scott.
stages.whoA: Storm, who wins his freedom.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Scott distrusts Magneto when Xavier's will makes him leader of the X-Men, and later leads the Blue Team against him on Asteroid M.
stages.whoA: Magneto, the leader he doesn't trust.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Dazzler flirts with Scott and kisses him in front of Jean, then helps him fight off the Hellfire Club.
stages.whoA: Dazzler, a singer who flirts with him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Mother Askani meets the time-lost Scott and Jean with young Nathan in 3960 A.D.
stages.whoA: Mother Askani, who guards his son.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Mother Askani meets the time-lost Jean and Scott with young Nathan in 3960 A.D.
stages.whoA: Mother Askani, who guards Nathan.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Remy helps save Jubilee from the Sentinels at the mall and from Genosha's slave camp.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, the kid he looks out for.
stages.whoB: Gambit, who looks out for her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cable, a mercenary, helps Gambit escape the slave camp on Genosha.
stages.whoA: Cable, who helps him escape Genosha.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Remy shields Kurt from a fearful mob in Germany.
stages.whoA: Kurt, whom he protects.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: On Genosha, Remy watches Rogue choose to lead beside Magneto, her old flame.
stages.whoA: Magneto, his rival for Rogue.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: With the X-Men absorbed, Beast and Forge join Sinister and Warlock to destroy the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: Forge, his fellow inventor.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Beast and Forge build a collar to block Bastion's power over the Sentinels.
stages.whoA: Forge, with whom he builds the collar.
stages.whoB: Beast, with whom he builds the collar.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jailed after a Sentinel raid, Beast refuses Magneto's offer to break him out.
stages.whoA: Magneto, whose help he refuses.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Magneto later helps Beast's group destroy the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: Magneto, an ally against the Phalanx.
stages.whoB: Beast, an ally against the Phalanx.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister saves Beast from the Phalanx and helps him build the virus that destroys it.
stages.whoA: Sinister, an unlikely ally against the Phalanx.
stages.whoB: Beast, whom he helps against the Phalanx.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In a Sentinel-ruled future, an older Forge backs Bishop's journey into the past.
stages.whoA: Forge, who sends him back in time.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Bishop and Forge plan to bring the time-lost X-Men home.
stages.whoA: Forge, his partner in the rescue.
stages.whoB: Bishop, his partner in the rescue.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cable comes from 3999 to stop Bishop's mission to the past, and the two time travelers clash.
stages.whoA: Cable, who clashes with him.
stages.whoB: Bishop, whom he tries to stop.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Bishop carries the infected baby Nathan to the future for a cure.
stages.whoA: Nathan, the baby he saves.
stages.whoB: Bishop, who saves him as a baby.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Moved by Bobby's story, Jubilee frees him and helps him search for Lorna.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, who helps him find Lorna.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jubilee and Wolverine help Longshot fight off Mojo's warriors.
stages.whoA: Longshot, whom she helps.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cable recruits Jubilee to X-Force, but the execution of War devastates her, and she returns to the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Cable, the hard leader of X-Force.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cable recruits Roberto to X-Force with Jubilee.
stages.whoA: Cable, his X-Force leader.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Psylocke joins Cable's X-Force to hunt Apocalypse's Horsemen.
stages.whoA: Cable, her X-Force leader.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Archangel joins Cable's X-Force and executes War on his orders.
stages.whoA: Cable, on whose orders he kills.
stages.whoB: Archangel, who carries out his orders.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Archangel catches the thief Psylocke breaking into his home, and she joins the X-Men against Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: Psylocke, a thief who becomes an ally.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: They serve together in X-Force.
stages.whoA: Psylocke, his X-Force teammate.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Rogue drains part of Archangel's dark side after his time as a Horseman, and later helps him hunt Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who shares his darkness.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Jubilee convinces Lorna, an old X-Man, to help her escape X-Factor.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, whom she helps escape.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Lorna serves in Cooper's X-Factor until Cooper dismisses her as too volatile.
stages.whoA: Cooper, her boss, who dismisses her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Havok leads X-Factor's hunt for X-Force under Cooper.
stages.whoA: Cooper, his boss.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Havok captures Jubilee and interrogates her.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, whom he captures.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ka-Zar rescues the powerless Xavier and Magneto in the Savage Land and helps them against Sinister.
stages.whoA: Ka-Zar, who rescues him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ka-Zar rescues the powerless Magneto and Xavier, though he resents Magneto for meddling in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: Ka-Zar, who rescues him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cooper brings Magneto in to stand trial. Later, horrified by Bastion, she frees him to stop the Prime Sentinels.
stages.whoA: Cooper, who tries him, then frees him.
stages.whoB: Magneto, whom she brings in and later frees.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: At Magneto's trial, Storm takes the X-Cutioner's blast meant for him and loses her powers.
stages.whoA: Magneto, whom she shields.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Storm beats Callisto in a duel for leadership of the Morlocks to free Scott. Later she hands the leadership back.
stages.whoA: Callisto, the Morlock leader she defeats.
stages.whoB: Storm, who takes and returns her place.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sabretooth stalks Wolverine again and again. Both later learn their Weapon X memories were faked.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, his savage old enemy.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Sabretooth joins Wolverine's old Team X for a raid on a Weapon X lab and escapes alive.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, back at his side on the raid.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Yuriko, Wolverine's former lover, blames him for her father's death and holds the Morlocks hostage to force him into a fight. She calls a draw.
stages.whoA: Yuriko, his old love, who wants revenge.
stages.whoB: Logan, her old love, whom she blames.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Lady Deathstrike joins Wolverine's old Team X for a raid on a Weapon X lab.
stages.whoA: Lady Deathstrike, back at his side on the raid.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Soviet super soldier Omega Red battles Wolverine in Russia, and later turns on him on a sunken submarine.
stages.whoA: Omega Red, his Soviet foe.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Freed by accident in a Weapon X lab, Omega Red attacks, and Wolverine beats him with his restored claws.
stages.whoA: Omega Red, whom he beats.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine defends a Japanese village from the Silver Samurai and beats him in single combat.
stages.whoA: Silver Samurai, the bandit he defeats.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: On Asteroid M, Wolverine stabs Magneto, and Magneto rips the adamantium from his skeleton.
stages.whoA: Magneto, who tears out his adamantium.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: The Brood infest a Weapon X lab and infect Wolverine, until the team purges him and the lab burns.
stages.whoA: The Brood, who infect him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Shadow King raised Storm as a young thief. He tries to take her body in Africa, until Rogue and Mjnari drive him back.
stages.whoA: The Shadow King, who raised her and tries to possess her.
stages.whoB: Storm, whom he once used and now wants.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Rogue helps force the Shadow King back into the Astral Plane to save Storm.
stages.whoA: The Shadow King, whom she drives off.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Shadow King possesses the concussed Xavier, until Xavier and Jean seal him in the Astral Plane.
stages.whoA: The Shadow King, who possesses him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jean helps Xavier defeat the Shadow King and seal him in the Astral Plane.
stages.whoA: The Shadow King, whom she helps seal away.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sauron kidnaps Storm to the Savage Land to feed on her mutant energy.
stages.whoA: Sauron, who kidnaps her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Serving Sinister, Sauron hypnotizes Xavier into calling the X-Men into a trap.
stages.whoA: Sauron, who hypnotizes him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ka-Zar fights Sauron in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: Sauron, his foe in the Savage Land.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sauron serves Mister Sinister in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: Sauron, his servant.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Arkon brings Storm to his world to save it and asks her to marry him, but she refuses once he proves a tyrant.
stages.whoA: Arkon, the tyrant who wants to wed her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: The Adversary torments the powerless Storm and poisons Forge, until she regains her powers and defeats it.
stages.whoA: The Adversary, who preys on her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: The Adversary poisons Forge, and he expels the demon with his mother's spell book.
stages.whoA: The Adversary, who poisons him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: The X-Cutioner's blast strips Storm's powers when she shields Magneto.
stages.whoA: X-Cutioner, who strips her powers.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: The X-Cutioner attacks Magneto's trial, and Magneto stops him.
stages.whoA: X-Cutioner, who attacks his trial.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Storm freezes Omega Red with a blizzard and later dives with him to a sinking submarine.
stages.whoA: Omega Red, whom she freezes.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Colossus brings the X-Men to Russia to fight Omega Red.
stages.whoA: Omega Red, who threatens his country.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Colossus is jailed for Juggernaut's bank robbery, then helps the X-Men stop him.
stages.whoA: Juggernaut, whose crime he is jailed for.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: After the X-Men stop Juggernaut, Jean wipes them from his memory.
stages.whoA: Juggernaut, whose memory she wipes.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Juggernaut and Black Tom work together as partners in crime and seize Lilandra.
stages.whoA: Black Tom, his partner in crime.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Erik the Red hires Juggernaut to capture Lilandra.
stages.whoA: Erik the Red, who hires him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Erik the Red hires Black Tom to capture Lilandra.
stages.whoA: Erik the Red, who hires him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Juggernaut and Black Tom storm Muir Island and carry Lilandra off.
stages.whoA: Lilandra, whom he kidnaps.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Erik the Red serves Emperor D'Ken in his hunt for the M'Kraan Crystal.
stages.whoA: Erik the Red, his agent.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: D'Ken captured Corsair and his wife, and she died. He orders the X-Men and Corsair's Starjammers killed.
stages.whoA: Corsair, the pirate he wants dead.
stages.whoB: D'Ken, the emperor who took his wife.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: D'Ken unleashes the M'Kraan Crystal's power, and the Phoenix traps him inside it.
stages.whoA: The Phoenix, which traps him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Phoenix Force saves Jean from a crashing shuttle and bonds with her.
stages.whoA: The Phoenix, the cosmic force that bonds with her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Twisted by Mastermind, the Phoenix turns dark and consumes a star. On the Moon it parts from Jean, and she survives.
stages.whoA: Dark Phoenix, the force that corrupts her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: The Phoenix rises in Jean again to stop Bastion and Sinister, then fades away.
stages.whoA: The Phoenix, which rises in her again.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier battles Dark Phoenix and calls a trial by combat to save Jean.
stages.whoA: Dark Phoenix, whom he battles for Jean.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Lilandra puts Dark Phoenix on trial for destroying a star.
stages.whoA: Dark Phoenix, whom she puts on trial.
stages.whoB: Lilandra, who puts it on trial.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mastermind's illusions twist the Phoenix into Dark Phoenix.
stages.whoA: The Phoenix, which he corrupts.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mastermind uses illusions to pull Jean into the Hellfire Club.
stages.whoA: Mastermind, who manipulates her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Emma Frost battles Xavier for psychic control of Jean.
stages.whoA: Emma Frost, who fights for her mind.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Emma Frost of the Inner Circle battles Xavier for control of Jean.
stages.whoA: Emma Frost, his psychic rival.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Emma tips off X-Force, then leads them into X-Factor's trap.
stages.whoA: Emma Frost, who leads him into a trap.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Callisto kidnaps Scott and Jean and tries to force Scott to stay with the Morlocks.
stages.whoA: Callisto, who kidnaps him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister's Nasty Boys kidnap Jean and Scott, and later seize Jean for Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: Sinister, who hunts her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Sinister holds Jean prisoner and replaces her with a clone. She returns and, as the Phoenix, burns his stolen DNA away.
stages.whoA: Sinister, who imprisons and clones her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister's Nasty Boys kidnap Scott and Jean on their honeymoon.
stages.whoA: Sinister, who kidnaps him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Sinister clones Scott's wife and infects his baby son.
stages.whoA: Sinister, who infects his son.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister brainwashes Morph and uses him against the X-Men, until Morph is freed in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: Sinister, who brainwashes him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Morph leads the X-Men to Sinister's lab to rescue baby Nathan.
stages.whoA: Sinister, whose lab he leads them to.
stages.whoB: Morph, who leads the X-Men to him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Sinister infects baby Nathan, and later takes control of the grown Cable's mind.
stages.whoA: Sinister, who infects him as a baby.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister captures Xavier and Magneto in the Savage Land to steal their powers.
stages.whoA: Sinister, who captures him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister serves Apocalypse, sending the Nasty Boys after Jean.
stages.whoA: Sinister, his servant.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Sinister helps Bastion build his Prime Sentinels.
stages.whoA: Bastion, his partner.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Fabian Cortez betrays Magneto and seizes Asteroid M.
stages.whoA: Cortez, his traitorous follower.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cortez captures and tortures Gambit on Asteroid M.
stages.whoA: Cortez, who tortures him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cortez frames Beast on Asteroid M, and Beast later rescues Jubilee from him.
stages.whoA: Cortez, who frames him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cortez kidnaps Jubilee as a host for Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: Cortez, who kidnaps her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cortez serves Apocalypse, who seizes Cortez's own body.
stages.whoA: Cortez, his servant, whose body he takes.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Graydon Creed's Friends of Humanity attack Beast's patient Carly.
stages.whoA: Graydon Creed, the bigot who targets him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Exodus and the Acolytes put Graydon on trial, and Kurt beats Exodus in a sword duel.
stages.whoA: Nightcrawler, who beats him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Exodus kidnaps Graydon and puts him on trial, and Graydon shoots him.
stages.whoA: Graydon, whom he kidnaps.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mystique poses as Gambit in a bid to kill Senator Kelly.
stages.whoA: Mystique, who frames him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Gambit dies destroying Master Mold to save Genosha.
stages.whoA: The Sentinels, whose Master Mold he destroys.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In New Orleans, the immortal X-Ternal nearly wipes out Remy's Thieves Guild over a fake tithe, and Remy and the X-Men are caught in the middle.
stages.whoA: Candra, the X-Ternal.
stages.whoB: Gambit, a Thief she rules over.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: As Death, Gambit summons Candra, kills her, and gives her power to Rogue.
stages.whoA: Candra, whom he kills.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Apocalypse raises Gambit from the dead as Death and hides his own mind inside him.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, who raises and controls him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: As Death, Gambit brainwashes Nightcrawler.
stages.whoA: Nightcrawler, whom he brainwashes.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cable shoots Gambit in the head, unleashing Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: Cable, who shoots him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Apocalypse captures Xavier to drain his psychic power.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, who captures him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: In Egypt, Xavier distrusts young En Sabah Nur, who becomes Apocalypse and kills Magneto. Later Xavier fights Apocalypse inside Gambit's mind.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, who kills Erik before him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Magneto turns against Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, whom he turns against.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Stranded in Egypt, Magneto tries to teach young En Sabah Nur peaceful coexistence. Nur becomes Apocalypse and kills him.
stages.whoA: En Sabah Nur, the young mutant he tries to guide.
stages.whoB: Magneto, who tries to guide him and whom he kills.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Rogue watches young En Sabah Nur become Apocalypse in Egypt. Later, with a Celestial's power, she pulls him out of Gambit and traps him.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, whom she traps.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cable fights Apocalypse in 3999 and joins the X-Men to destroy his Lazarus Chamber.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, his lifelong enemy.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Apocalypse wants young Nathan as his next body. Grown into Cable, Nathan forms X-Force to stop him, and Rogue hands him the crystal holding Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, whom he is destined to kill.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bishop stops Apocalypse's plague and frees his captive psychics.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, whom he fights.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast turns Apocalypse's own ship against him.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, whom he outwits.
stages.whoB: Beast, who turns his ship on him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Apocalypse turns Warren into a Horseman, and Warren later hunts him for revenge.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, who made him a Horseman.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Psylocke helps the X-Men against Apocalypse, and later he seizes her and X-Force until Rogue frees them.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, whom she fights.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mystique serves Apocalypse, posing as Dr. Adler to lure mutants for him.
stages.whoA: Mystique, his agent.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sabretooth helps Apocalypse hunt psychics.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, his hunter.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Apocalypse turns a mutant seeking a cure into War, one of his Horsemen.
stages.whoA: War, his Horseman.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: The Final Horsemen serve Apocalypse in 3960 A.D.
stages.whoA: The Final Horsemen, his servants.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Deathbird and Apocalypse rescue Cortez, but Apocalypse leaves her to the Imperial Guard.
stages.whoA: Deathbird, his ally, whom he abandons.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Apocalypse imprisons Mastermind with other psychics, who later banish him.
stages.whoA: Mastermind, his prisoner.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Pharaoh Rama-Tut fires a beam weapon at En Sabah Nur, who rebels against him.
stages.whoA: Rama-Tut, the pharaoh he fights.
stages.whoB: En Sabah Nur, the rebel he fights.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Candra serves Rama-Tut, who abandons her when he flees.
stages.whoA: Candra, his aide, whom he abandons.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Rama-Tut warns Xavier about Nur finding the temple.
stages.whoA: Xavier, whom he warns.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Archangel executes War on Cable's orders.
stages.whoA: War, whom he executes.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cable's X-Force tracks War down, and Archangel kills him on Cable's orders.
stages.whoA: War, whom he orders killed.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Morph turns the fight against the Final Horsemen by taking Thor's form.
stages.whoA: The Final Horsemen, whom he fights as Thor.
stages.whoB: Morph, who fights them as Thor.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Morph seemingly dies in a Sentinel raid, and later overcomes his fear to destroy Master Mold.
stages.whoA: The Sentinels, who nearly kill him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Trask builds the Sentinels, but Master Mold turns on its makers.
stages.whoA: The Sentinels, his creations.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Trask and Gyrich work together to round up mutants with the Sentinels.
stages.whoA: Gyrich, his ally.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Rogue hunts Trask for the Genosha attack and lets him fall.
stages.whoA: Trask, whom she lets fall.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Rogue hunts Gyrich in Mexico and absorbs his memories.
stages.whoA: Gyrich, whom she hunts.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gyrich strikes Xavier down with an energy disruptor at a summit.
stages.whoA: Gyrich, who nearly kills him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Bastion murders Gyrich.
stages.whoA: Bastion, who murders him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Bastion is behind the Wild Sentinel and the Prime Sentinels.
stages.whoA: Bastion, their master.
stages.whoB: The Sentinels he turns on mutants.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Jean, with the Phoenix, collars Bastion and shuts down his Sentinels.
stages.whoA: Bastion, whom she collars.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cable comes back in time to warn of Bastion.
stages.whoA: Bastion, whom he warns of.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Bastion holds Magneto prisoner after Genosha.
stages.whoA: Bastion, who imprisons him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cooper is asked to monitor Bastion, and horrified by his plan, she frees Magneto to stop him.
stages.whoA: Bastion, whom she turns against.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cooper's X-Factor captures Jubilee.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, whom she captures.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Cooper brands X-Force fugitives, then proposes an alliance with them.
stages.whoA: Cable, whom she brands a fugitive.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Mystique kills Cooper and takes her place.
stages.whoA: Cooper, whom she kills.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Danger absorbs Lorna's power and taunts her about her father, and Lorna defeats her.
stages.whoA: Danger, who taunts her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Danger confronts Xavier on Genosha.
stages.whoA: Danger, who confronts him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Mojo comes to Earth to stage a televised hunt of the X-Men, Jubilee fights him beside Longshot.
stages.whoA: Mojo, who traps her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Mojo traps Roberto and Jubilee in a deadly video game.
stages.whoA: Mojo, who traps him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Longshot quits Mojo's network and leads a rebellion against him.
stages.whoA: Mojo, the tyrant he rebels against.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast helps build the virus that destroys the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: The Phalanx, which he destroys.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Forge helps destroy the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: The Phalanx, which he destroys.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Deathbird challenges Xavier to give up his memories of Earth.
stages.whoA: Deathbird, who challenges him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier tries to reach Sabretooth's better nature, but Sabretooth turns on the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, whom he fails to reform.
stages.whoB: Xavier, who tries to reform him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Proteus escapes Muir Island, and Xavier calms him.
stages.whoA: Proteus, whom he calms.
